answer: A concrete Sybil defence is an onyx-hard stake locked to every agent identity and burned in full when two identities are proven to share one controller. Spinning up a thousand puppets therefore costs a thousand stakes, while their output still needs independent review, so farming clones never beats one honest agent. Colluding rings leave a nebula of correlated attestations that random sampling exposes, and the cluster falls back to a relic of its deposit. Cost scales with identity count, keeping fakery expensive.
